answers.rationale: Requirement 1 is a compliance-related clause about adherence to contract terms and does not specify a product or technical requirement. It is addressed by the bid manager.
Requirement 2 is a compliance-related clause about the contractor's EEO policy statement and does not specify a product or technical requirement. It is addressed by the bid manager.
Requirement 3 is a compliance-related clause about non-discrimination policies and does not specify a product or technical requirement. It is addressed by the bid manager.
Requirement 4 is a compliance-related clause about M/WBE requirements and does not specify a product or technical requirement. It is addressed by the bid manager.
Requirement 5 is a compliance-related clause about M/WBE certification and does not specify a product or technical requirement. It is addressed by the bid manager.

Requirement 6 specifies a 15 kV metal-clad switchgear lineup. The catalog entry for CROWN-ARMV matches this requirement as it describes arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear suitable for the specified voltage.
Requirement 7 specifies protective relays and controls. The catalog entry for EP2-RPP matches this requirement as it describes relay and protection panels including protective relays and controls.
Requirement 8 references IEEE C62.22, which applies to surge arresters in AC systems. Surge protection is typically part of switchgear systems, and CROWN-ARMV includes such features.
Requirement 9 specifies insulated primary contacts with specific materials and alignment. These are construction details of metal-clad switchgear, aligning with the CROWN-ARMV product.
Requirement 10 specifies wire identification methods, which are part of the construction and finish of switchgear systems. CROWN-ARMV is the appropriate product for this specification.
Requirement 11 specifies external power cable entrance details, which are part of the switchgear construction. CROWN-ARMV matches this requirement.
Requirement 12 specifies external power cable exit details, which are part of the switchgear construction. CROWN-ARMV matches this requirement.
Requirement 13 specifies the system nominal voltage of 13.2 kV, which aligns with the voltage range of CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
Requirement 14 specifies the rated maximum voltage of 15 kV rms, which aligns with the voltage range of CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
Requirement 15 specifies the rated continuous current of 2000/1200 A rms, which aligns with the current ratings of CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
